transformations: Host paths in result/capture metadata replaced with relative paths.
Stop record reduced to status, timing, source preservation and stop confirmations.
Reasoning/encrypted reasoning and API response metadata omitted from public conversation. All tool actions/results retained.
Authentication-error body omitted; failure still recorded.
Provider request/response IDs and repeated raw histories are retained privately; raw SHA256s are published per request.
caveat: Hashes establish consistency of supplied artifacts; they are not independent proof of provider authorship.
